segments.t: Max turns up late to the kitchen and has a lame excuse ready. Chef Barinov sends him to the stockroom and asks Vika what she thinks. The original language first.
Ещё раз проспишь — я тебя уволю.
Повар должен приходить на работу вовремя.
Я обещаю больше никогда не опаздывать.
Виктория Сергеевна, почему вы так молчите?
Надо раньше ложиться спать, чтобы не проспать.
Вот видите, она со мной согласна.
Again, and this time listen out for the excuses.
'Hi to everyone.' Let's inspect the sentence:
means 'to everyone'. Max says 'hi to all', using
'Boss, excuse me, I simply overslept.' The term for 'overslept',
, is made from the term to sleep, with a prefix meaning 'through'. The term
supplies a polite form for a boss.
'Such a thing will not happen again.' The language says 'will not repeat itself',
, and the 'itself' is in the ending. The term for 'more',
, stands in for 'any more' at the front.
'Today you are working in the stockroom.' Notice for 'you work',
, is used for 'you are working' and 'you will work'. The expression for 'in the stockroom',
, is literally 'on the store', and uses the usual word for 'on'.
Ещё раз проспишь — я тебя уволю.
'Oversleep one more time — I will fire you.' No 'if' appears in the sentence. It is 'one more time you oversleep, I fire you',
, and the dash does the work of 'then'.
'But boss, I am an excellent cook.' With no 'am' it is just 'I excellent cook', which makes it sound blunt. The term for 'excellent',
, is a word you'll hear for 'excellent' and for the top mark in school.
Повар должен приходить на работу вовремя.
'A cook must arrive at work on time.' Notice for 'on time',
, literally says 'in time', glued together from 'in' and 'time'. Notice for arriving on foot,
Я обещаю больше никогда не опаздывать.
'I promise to never be late again.' The language happily piles up 'more', 'never', and 'not', using
, literally 'more never not be late'. That triple negative is correct, and the verb for 'to be late' is
'I have said my word.' Notice for 'my own word',
, matches the gender of 'word'. It is a set phrase, a bit like saying 'my word is final'.
Виктория Сергеевна, почему вы так молчите?
'Victoria Sergeyevna, why are you so silent?' Barinov uses the polite formal 'you' and her full name with patronymic. Notice for 'you are silent' is
Надо раньше ложиться спать, чтобы не проспать.
'It is necessary to go to bed earlier to not oversleep.' Locals say 'lay yourself to sleep',
, for going to bed. Then the expression for 'in order to',
, brings in the thing to avoid.
Вот видите, она со мной согласна.
'Here you see, she agrees with me.' Notice for 'there, you see',
, is the stock expression for 'told you so'. The ending on the word for 'agrees',
, shows that the agreeing person is a woman. Now the whole scene again.
Ещё раз проспишь — я тебя уволю.
Повар должен приходить на работу вовремя.
Я обещаю больше никогда не опаздывать.
Виктория Сергеевна, почему вы так молчите?
Надо раньше ложиться спать, чтобы не проспать.
Вот видите, она со мной согласна.
Max is sent down to the stockroom for the day. Vika sided with the boss, so Max walks to work alone and works alone. Bye for now.
